title: MLCongress Response To Desai Liaquat
definition: The Desai-Liaquat Pact (1945) was an informal, unauthorized proposal for an interim government between Bhulabhai Desai (Congress) and Liaquat Ali Khan (Muslim League), which ultimately failed due to lack of official endorsement from both parties' high commands.
importanceInUpsc: It represents the critical 'failed bridge' phase of the 1945 political negotiations, highlighting the deep-seated mistrust between the INC and ML, and serves as a precursor to the Wavell Plan.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of MLCongress Response To Desai Liaquat.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
